description: HTML source code for a database visualizer web interface including styling, structure, and client-side scripting for database and table selection, data fetching, and display.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands/collapses database to show or hide tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for table data display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual table cell with handling for objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better viewing.
